responsibility: Declares the M32R backend’s option-level enums and convenience macros for code model and small-data-area selection. It defines the internal representations of -mmodel=small/medium/large and -msdata=none/sdata/use, default selections, and derived predicates such as TARGET_ADDR24, TARGET_ADDR32, TARGET_CALL32, and TARGET_SDATA_USE that the rest of the port uses to choose address size, call sequence style, and placement/access policy for SDA objects.
